connector.name: EdgeDepth Research
connector.registryDescription: Search recorded crypto and TradFi microstructure through deterministic, reproducible agent tools.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.edgedepth.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package research-mcp. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace com.edgedepth. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: EDGEDEPTH_API_KEY
env.description: Required for the stdio package. Hosted remote clients use browser OAuth instead.
